youtube_short.title: Your Home Insurance Is Missing $63,000
title_alternatives: The Hidden Word in Your Policy That Costs $63K
ACV vs RCV: The Insurance Trap Nobody Warns You About
youtube_short.description: 60% of American homes are underinsured — and most people don't find out until after a disaster. Your policy probably says 'ACV' (actual cash value), which pays out what your stuff is worth today, not what it costs to replace it. A 5-year-old TV that cost $800? You're getting $120. The average shortfall after a typical claim is $63,000 out of pocket. Upgrading to replacement cost value (RCV) costs about $120/year more — that's 33 cents a day to close a $63,000 gap. Check your policy tonight. #homeinsurance #personalfinance #insurance #moneytips

hook_line: Your home insurance is hiding a $63,000 gap
